pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHY ARE YOU TAKING SO LONG TO PUT AWAY THE OIL? HURRY UP!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'LL GET IT DONE RIGHT AWAY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OH, OOPS. A DELIVERY? I DIDN'T KNOW WE WERE EXPECTING ONE.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: OH, WAIT A MINUTE! WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR THAT SORT OF THING TODAY!

pages.speaker: character18
pages.text: LADY MAO IS BEING WED TO LORD SHIONO.
